title: A runner killed by procs --end or a manager exit leaves status.json running, vanishes from status, and a dirty or diverged orch worktree refuses forever
goal: autopilot.py runner start installs SIGTERM and SIGHUP handlers that end the child's process tree and write a status with its cause, status shows a record whose cause is running while no live runner holds it as ended with the cause error instead of dropping it, and the manager tick has a recovery step (name the cause, end or reset the stale worktree) for a prepare_worktree refusal (dirty or diverged orch/SP) so the refusal does not repeat every tick; planted-failure tests cover each; found by the SP-4xngzagf review
